name: Jordan Lee
headline: Operations Manager | Supply Chain, Vendor Management and Process Improvement
summary: Operations professional with 6+ years of experience managing multi-site logistics and vendor relationships. Delivered process improvements and reporting systems using SQL, Excel and Salesforce. Experienced in taking initiatives from pilot through company-wide rollout.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Rebuilt the weekly reporting pipeline in SQL and Excel, reducing manual reconciliation work by approximately 20%.
Managed a multi-state vendor portfolio of 40+ suppliers, renegotiating contract terms across 12 accounts.
Led a five-person cross-departmental rollout of a new scheduling system, delivering on schedule across 3 sites.
Introduced a standardized intake checklist for new clients, reducing missing-document follow-ups and simplifying onboarding.
Reduced average vendor onboarding time from 15 to 9 business days by redesigning the intake workflow.

experience.title: Operations Lead
bullets: Led onboarding-process redesign across three regional warehouses, standardizing compliance documentation.
Coordinated inventory planning for a 200,000 sq. ft. distribution center, cutting stockouts by 15%.
Trained and supervised a team of 8 warehouse associates across two shifts.

experience.title: Operations Coordinator
bullets: Processed and tracked over 500 monthly vendor purchase orders using NetSuite.
Assisted in migrating vendor records from spreadsheets to a centralized SAP database.

projects.name: Community Food Bank Logistics Volunteer Program
bullets: Designed a volunteer scheduling system for a 30-person weekly distribution effort, reducing no-show rate by roughly 25%.
